sahneler.alt: A _clue_, not a diagnosis on its own
cumleler: The threshold drops clearly at four thousand hertz.
At eight thousand hertz it improves again; this is called recovery.
Such a notch is typical of noise-induced hearing loss.
Still, the audiogram alone is not a diagnosis; history matters too.
